risks-and-thesis-breakers.text: The Purchase Agreement will terminate automatically on the earliest to occur of (i) the first day of the month next following the 14-month anniversary of the date of the Purchase Agreement, (ii) the date on which Cantor has purchased the Total Commitment of shares of Common Stock under the Purchase Agreement, (iii) the date on which the Common Stock fails to be listed or quoted on The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC or a specified alternative market and (iv) the commencement of certain bankruptcy or insolvency proceedings with respect to the Company. The Company has the right to terminate the Purchase Agreement at any time after Commencement, at no cost or penalty, upon three trading days’ prior written notice to Cantor, provided that the Upfront Commitment Fee and any Additional Commitment Fee (including any Additional Commitment Fee determined by reference to a Measurement Date occurring on the effective date of such termination) payable have theretofore been paid.
